name: Night Hawk
notes: Own site (thebabygrandcoronado.com/night-hawk) links to three first-party menus, all read directly: full food menu image (Mezze/Bread, Vegetables, Pasta & Grains, Sea Creatures, Skewers, Wood Roasted, After/desserts), a brunch PDF (NH_Brunch_June4.pdf, single-column breakfast section extracted with pdftotext -layout; the rest of that PDF repeats the same food menu already captured from the image), and a 5-page drink PDF (RedDiecut_NH_DrinkMenu2.pdf). Cocktails and non-alcoholic drinks captured from the drink PDF; the by-the-glass/bottle wine list (roughly 150 bottles, $45-$1700) was excluded as an adjunct back-bar-style list, not a dish menu. All prices whole-dollar, no markup test applicable (no third-party source to compare, own site only).
